use default
use System

let table =
    "Add ALTer  BAckup Bottom  CAppend Change SCHANGE  CInsert CLAst "
    "COMPress COpy COUnt COVerlay CURsor DELete CDelete Down DUPlicate "
    "Xedit EXPand EXTract Find NFind NFINDUp NFUp CFind FINdup FUp "
    "FOrward GET Help HEXType Input POWerinput Join SPlit SPLTJOIN  LOAD "
    "Locate CLocate  LOWercase UPPercase  LPrefix MACRO MErge MODify MOve "
    "MSG Next Overlay PARSE PREServe PURge PUT PUTD  Query  QUIT READ "
    "RECover REFRESH RENum REPeat  Replace CReplace  RESet  RESTore "
    "RGTLEFT RIght LEft  SAVE  SET SHift SI  SORT  SOS  STAck STATus "
    "TOP TRAnsfer Type Up"

minimum_length(command: string) -> int =>
    command |> filter(letter => char.is_upper(letter)) |> count()

let commands =
    table.split([' '], StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)
    |> map(command =>
        (word = command, minimum = minimum_length(command)))
    |> collect_list()

matches(command: (word: string, minimum: int), word: string) -> bool =>
    word.length >= command.minimum /\
    word.length <= command.word.length /\
    string.compare(
        command.word.substring(0, word.length),
        word,
        StringComparison.ORDINAL_IGNORE_CASE
    ) == 0

expand(word: string) -> string =>
    commands
    |> filter(command => matches(command, word))
    |> map(command => command.word.to_upper())
    |> first() ?? "*error*"

let input =
    "riG   rePEAT copies  put mo   rest    types   fup.    6       "
    "poweRin"

write_line(
    input.split([' '], StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)
    |> map(expand)
    |> join(" ")
)
